brand.name: Paper & Loop
brand.target_audience: 15-30 y/o, mobile-first, scroll-native (Gen Z / anime fans, gamers, car enthusiasts, collectors).

primary.name: Brand Orange
primary.usage: accent only (≤10% viewport) - buttons, cursors, badges, highlight lines

colors.theme_strategy: Alternating sections dark→light→dark for scroll rhythm.

spacing_and_layout.borders: 1px solid border-black/10 (light mode) or border-white/10 (dark mode)
spacing_and_layout.radii: rounded-none or rounded-sm (sharp, premium editorial feel, max 4px)

motion_and_interactions.floating_cards: ±6px oscillation on Y-axis (repeat: infinity, duration: 4s, ease: easeInOut)
motion_and_interactions.cursor: custom cursor (dot + trailing ring), cursor-follow orange glow. Native cursor hidden.
motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: product card image swap (flat poster -> lifestyle context), 3D tilt (react-parallax-tilt or framer-motion), magnetic buttons.
motion_and_interactions.cart_animation: fly-to-cart arc animation using Framer Motion layoutId or explicit coordinates.
motion_and_interactions.order_timeline: animated progress bar with glowing active states and staggered step reveals.

product_card.layout: aspect-[3/4] relative overflow-hidden group bg-gray-100 dark:bg-zinc-900
product_card.image: default image is flat poster. On hover: crossfade to lifestyle/room image.
product_card.badges: absolute top-4 left-4 flex flex-col gap-2 (New, Trending, Limited) - crisp typography, sharp corners, bg-[#FF6A00] text-white px-2 py-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider
product_card.actions: Quick View, Wishlist, Add to Cart appearing on hover (translate-y-0 from translate-y-4, opacity-100 from 0).

hero_section.layout: min-h-[90vh] flex flex-col justify-end pb-12 relative overflow-hidden
hero_section.cta: magnetic button, primary brand orange #FF6A00, sharp rect shape px-8 py-4 text-white font-bold tracking-widest uppercase

navigation.style: sticky top-0 z-50 glassmorphic (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 dark:bg-black/60) with 1px bottom border border-white/10.
navigation.layout: Logo left, Links center, Icons right (Search, User, Cart). Mobile: Bottom tab bar for core nav, sticky add-to-cart on PDP.

cart_drawer.style: slide-out from right (framer-motion x: '100%' to 0). Dark overlay background.
cart_drawer.content: Fly-to-cart animation destination. Displays items, subtotal with digit-roll, and massive Checkout button.

room_preview.style: PDP specific tool. Split screen or modal.
room_preview.function: Composite the selected poster design onto a real bedroom/gaming setup mockup (using a fixed base image and overlaying the poster image in a specific div with absolute positioning and perspective).

checkout_gpay.interactions: Mocking the payment verification with a loading spinner -> Success state.

page_layouts.home: Hero -> Featured Collections (marquee or horizontal scroll) -> Best Sellers (4-up grid) -> Trending -> Coming Soon (T-shirts/Hoodies teaser) -> Why Choose Us (bento grid) -> Instagram Gallery (masonry) -> Testimonials -> Newsletter -> Footer
page_layouts.collections: Sticky filters on left + category chips top -> Product Grid
page_layouts.pdp: Split screen desktop: Sticky purchase card on right (price, variants, add to cart), scrollable gallery on left. Room Preview button. Related products below.
page_layouts.admin_dashboard: Sidebar navigation (sharp edges). Data dense tables. Stats cards. Order timeline management.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has background overlays or text-shadows. Orange #FF6A00 on white needs large text or careful contrast checking.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion: reduce for heavy 3D and floating animations.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use framer-motion heavily for all UI interactions: hero staggered reveals, line-masks, floating cards, magnetic buttons, and page transitions.
Implement a custom cursor component that tracks mouse position globally and adds an orange glow effect.
For the Room Preview feature, create a container with the room setup image as background, and absolute position the poster image on the wall with appropriate box-shadow and perspective.

Keep typography tight and editorial. Do NOT use Inter or Roboto. Use 'Cabinet Grotesk', 'Satoshi', or standard fallback like 'system-ui' but stylized heavily. Import from Google Fonts or local assets if possible, else rely on close fallbacks.
Alternate section backgrounds between #0A0A0A (Dark) and #F1F1EF / #FAFAF9 (Light) for strong scroll rhythm.
Mobile layout MUST use a bottom tab bar and sticky Add to Cart on PDP.
Build the GPay QR checkout flow as a simulated multi-step process with a fake verification delay.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use standard icon libraries like lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Do not use complete transparent background in header or overlays. Ensure text is readable.
